datasets.purpose: Acutely Food Insecure Population Estimates in different scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) surveys across Malawi to estimate acutely food insecure populations under different scenarios. Population estimates were aggregated to produce most-likely scenario projections of food insecurity prevalence, reflecting drought-driven food security impacts.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Famine Early Warning Systems Network (FEWS NET) acutely food insecure population estimates collected through regular enumerator surveys. Provides scenario-based projections of food insecurity prevalence at national and sub-national levels.
